scenarios.name: enters-lose-life-equal-to-life-total-but-stay-in-the-game
scenarios.why: Oracle: As Lich enters, you lose life equal to your life total; you don't lose the game for having 0 or less life. p0 (20 life) casts Lich: the 'as enters' event is a replacement (614.1c) so p0 loses 20 life as it enters, reaching 0, and the second static keeps the state-based action 704.5a from ending the game. Lich stays on the battlefield and p0 is still in the game with 0 life.

scenarios.name: life-gain-draws-cards-instead
scenarios.why: Oracle: If you would gain life, draw that many cards instead. p0 casts Lich (losing all 20 life as it enters), then Angel's Mercy ('You gain 7 life'): with Lich on the battlefield p0 draws 7 cards instead of gaining life, so p0's life stays 0 and p0 holds the 7 cards from the library.
